title: The Grey Tooth
journal: Never-Writes-Twice read the parchment map from Vicrium and named the tooth-shaped crag: the Grey Tooth, the seamark of Skeith Isle. The Collector's hired men are camped at the foot of its goat-path and dig in a small cave on its north face. I'm to find out what they found in the Grey Tooth Cave. I may fight them or slip past them.
objectives: Find what the Collector's men found in the Grey Tooth Cave. (marker: Door to Grey Tooth Cave, Vanin's Rubbing)

plan.going: I am a Toh-Wo of the Toh-Reel-Ka on the hunt for the Root and the Eye. The parchment map led to the Grey Tooth on Skeith Isle, and the Collector's men got there first.
plan.next: Go to the Grey Tooth (boat to Archon, then Arorha, then on foot) and see what the Collector's men found in the cave on its north face.
plan.ways: Fight the three hired men (any weapon or magic), or pass them by stealth.

answers: I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka, the order of the Xeech-Leel, who want to find the Eye of Argonia before the Unbound (Cuts-the-Old-Knot) do, because the Hist trees are sickening. The map from Vicrium led me to the Grey Tooth, the seamark of Skeith Isle, where the Collector (Ennodius Vanin) has hired men camped and digging in a cave.
Find what the Collector men found in the Grey Tooth Cave, on its north face.
Fight the three hirelings, or sneak past them (my build favours sneaking) to the cave door; also there is Vanins Rubbing here to look at.
I do not fully understand what the Collector is after here or what the rubbing shows; I can read the rubbing and look in the cave to find out.

title: The Grey Tooth
journal: In the Grey Tooth Cave I found an empty niche and the Collector's rubbing of a sailor's scratch above it: the stone was carried off to the Stormwidow by her captain's order. The Stormwidow lies beached on the south-west shore of Skeith Isle, and the Collector has sold her name to someone who will dig for him. I'm to search the wreck's hold for the stone. I may fight whoever is there or slip past them.
objectives: Find the kings' stone in the hold of the Wreck of the Stormwidow. (marker: Door to Stormwidow's Hold, Stormwidow's Ballast Crate)

plan.going: The stone from the cave's niche went to the Stormwidow twenty years ago; the Collector sold that to someone.
plan.next: Search the hold of the Wreck of the Stormwidow, on the south-west beach, for the stone.
plan.ways: Fight whoever is in the hold, or pass them by stealth.

answers: The cave niche is empty; the Collector rubbing says the stone was shipped off on the Stormwidow by her captain 181, and the ship lies on the south-west beach of Skeith Isle. The Collector has sold her name to diggers. I still work for the Toh-Reel-Ka hunting the Eye before the Unbound.
Go to the Wreck of the Stormwidow, south-west shore, and search the hold for the kings stone.
Fight whoever is there or sneak past; the marker points to the hold door and a ballast crate.
I do not know what the kings stone is exactly or what it does; presumably another key toward the Root. I would learn by finding it.

title: The Grey Tooth
journal: Unbound scouts were searching the Stormwidow's hold, and I took the kings' marker stone from a ballast crate before them. It is carved with seven towers standing in water, one cut deeper than the rest. The scouts had the recipe for their seal with them. A wounded scout lies on the sand below the bow. I'm to hear what she has to say.
objectives: Speak to the wounded scout below the Stormwidow's bow. (marker: Tah-Leesh)

plan.going: I have the marker stone, which shows seven towers in water with one marked. The Unbound wanted it too.
plan.next: Speak to the wounded scout on the sand below the Stormwidow's bow.
plan.ways: Talk to her; she is unarmed and does not fight.

answers: I took the Kings Marker Stone from the ballast crate before the Unbound scouts. It shows seven towers in water, one cut deeper; it likely ties to the seven-tower map from Vicrium and the way to the Root and the Eye. The scouts had the seal recipe (grey caps and dried root paste).
Speak to the wounded scout Tah-Leesh below the bow of the Stormwidow.
Talk to her, or fight the Unbound scouts, or leave; I prefer to talk.
I do not know which of the seven towers is the deep-cut one or where the towers are; maybe Tah-Leesh or the order knows.

title: The Grey Tooth
journal: The wounded scout, Tah-Leesh, told me that her leader, Cuts-the-Old-Knot, says whoever serves the Toh-Reel-Ka should ask what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth. She did not know what it meant. I'm to bring the marker stone to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka's House in Helstrom.
objectives: Bring the marker stone to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka's House, Helstrom. (marker: Never-Writes-Twice)

plan.going: I have the marker stone. Cuts-the-Old-Knot wants the order's people to ask what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth, an Archwarden fort.
plan.next: Bring the stone to Never-Writes-Twice at the back of Nesh-Deeka's House in Helstrom.
plan.ways: One way, the report. I may ask her about Fort Chalkmoth there.

answers: Tah-Leesh, a wounded Unbound scout abandoned by her fellows, said Cuts-the-Old-Knot tells anyone serving the Toh-Reel-Ka to ask what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth, the Archwardens fort on the Chixathe Mesa. It hints the order hides something, maybe related to Nesh-Deekas knowledge of the Unbound.
Bring the Kings Marker Stone to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka House, Helstrom.
Go straight back as ordered, or first investigate Fort Chalkmoth cellar myself; I can also ask Never-Writes-Twice about the moaning.
I do not understand what moans in Fort Chalkmoth cellar, or why the Unbound leader says it about the order. I could ask Never-Writes-Twice or go look.

title: The Grey Tooth
journal: Never-Writes-Twice read the marker stone. The marked tower is one of the drowned spires off Lilmoth, and the divers of Bell Station, east of Lilmoth, will know which; finding the tower is the order's hunt, and she paid me a hundred gold. I asked her about Fort Chalkmoth. She said it is a fort like any other, but someone moans in its cellar, and I mean to see it for myself on my own account. I'm to go to Bell Station for the hunt, or to Fort Chalkmoth first; either may come first.

plan.going: The marker stone points to a drowned spire off Lilmoth; Bell Station's divers will know which. Never-Writes-Twice calls Fort Chalkmoth a fort like any other, though something moans in its cellar.
plan.next: Two things are open, in either order: the order's hunt, at Bell Station (MN13), and my own errand to see the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth (MN12).

answers: The marker stone shows seven drowned spires off Lilmoth on the sea floor of Benthic Yobesh, one marked deeper; Never-Writes-Twice took the stone and paid me 100 gold. The quest The Grey Tooth is complete. Never-Writes-Twice brushed off the Fort Chalkmoth rumour, which makes me a little suspicious.
Go by boat from Lilmoth to Bell Station and ask its divers which tower is the marked one; or first visit Fort Chalkmoth on the Chixathe Mesa above Noota Nara.
Bell Station first as the order wishes, or Chalkmoth first to see who moans in the cellar.
I do not know what moans in the cellar, nor which tower is marked; the divers at Bell Station should know.
